title: 情報科教育法
subtitle: Educational Methods for Information
teachers:
KIMURA Tatsuya
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal: In this course, students will acquire basic knowledge as a teacher who teaches "information", and acquire practical skills that will enable them to properly conduct a lesson of Informatics in high school.
advice:
In the first half of this course, knowledge is mainly for the subject “Informatics”, and in the second half, the skills are mainly. This course covers items as below.
 1. Basic knowledge required to take charge of subject “Informatics”
  1) The objectives of information education
  2) Importance of Informatics in the current education
  3) Information literacy
  4) The course of study of subject “Informatics”
  5) Lesson plan and teaching materials of subject “Informatics”
 2. Basic skills required to take charge of subject “Informatics”
  1) Creating a lesson plan and teaching materials
  2) Demonstration of a lesson of subject “Informatics”
  3) Reflection on the lesson
  4) Improving a lesson
books: The Course of Study “Information”, by Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology, JAPAN
requiredKnowledge: To have basic knowledge of Informatics, which includes adequate use of information and basic skills for a computer.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain the significance of subject “Informatics”.
Be able to make and conduct a lesson of subject “Informatics”.
Be able to describe the improvements of your lesson.
Be able to describe the good points and the points to be improved of others’ lesson.
Engage in this course and self-evaluate objectives of this course to be achieved.

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1) Understand the significance of the subject "Informatics" in the whole curriculum, and design a lesson considering it.

(2) Design and conduct a lesson of the subject "Informatics" corresponding to the student's reaction in the lesson.

(3) Recognize the good points of your lesson and make an adequate of the subject "Informatics".

(4) Recognize the improvements of your lesson and make an adequate of the subject “Informatics”.
achievementLevels.standard:
(1) Understand the significance of the subject "Informatics" in the whole curriculum.

(2) Design and conduct a lesson of the subject "Informatic".

(3) Recognize the good points of your lesson.

(4) Recognize the improvements of your lesson.
